prompt:
Create exactly one clean, production-ready 2D side-view game sprite of the Stalker from Silent Hill (1999), specifically the armed shadow manifestation of Nowhere, roster sh1_stalker_008. This is a newly authored static presentation, not an animation sheet.

IDENTITY AND REFERENCES: The first four images are documentary renders of the original CLD2.ILM mesh posed by CLD2.ANM frame477, with its own CLD2.TIM texture: right profile, front, rear and three-quarter. Their full silhouette, head shape, limbs, hands, feet and knife are the geometry authority. This is CLD2, not the different CLD1 Larval Stalker or CLD3 Grey Child. The fifth image is the original released Nowhere scene reproduced in the official Lost Memories guide; use it only for the dark shadow manifestation, never for a missing limb or body contour. The archive renders deliberately expose the mesh and brown texture; the requested game manifestation should read as a dim, dark, partially transparent silhouette, as it appears in Nowhere. Do not turn it into a brightly lit flesh creature.

COMPOSITION: Exactly one subject, all head, body, both hands, both feet and the entire one knife visible. Strict orthographic 90-degree lateral view facing screen RIGHT. Head, shoulders, pelvis and both feet all face right, no three-quarter turn toward the viewer. Full body centered with generous transparent margins, minimum about 7 percent top and bottom; the entire knife must remain in frame. Vertical canvas, preferably 1024 by 1536. No inset, frame, labels, grid or text.

FORM: Retain the original compact nonhuman humanoid proportions and sloping, unusually large, smooth egg-shaped cranium with its slanted front profile and almost absent neck. Modestly stooped upper back; long hanging arms; narrow shoulders and plain tapered torso; original two jointed legs and blunt broad feet. Keep the source's sparse, indistinct facial marks extremely subdued. Do not invent horns, hair, tentacles, flowing clothing, armor, giant claws or glowing eyes. Preserve the source knife: a small straight handle and single long narrow triangular blade carried in the right hand, held low beside and slightly ahead of the thigh, pointing down and forward. The blade and holding hand are fully visible.

POSE: Quiet grounded idle derived from the source silhouette, slight forward lean and bent knees, feet a modest distance apart on exactly the same horizontal contact baseline; no walking stride, levitation or jump. Far arm and far leg remain subtly separated so both are legible while the whole figure stays a true lateral profile. No attack scene and no second figure.

RENDERING: A restrained high-quality game sprite with coherent dark charcoal, black and muted warm-brown values. The shadow's substance is partly transparent throughout with soft but controlled edges, subtle source-like mottling and very little internal facial detail. Preserve enough density for the profile and low knife to remain readable against either a light or dark game stage. Show a complete bounded silhouette, including feet; no fog cloud, disconnected particles or trailing smoke extending below the soles. Non-graphic, no wounds or blood, no anatomical detail. The sprite is isolated on genuine transparent RGBA alpha. No background color, checkerboard baked into pixels, floor, cast shadow, scenery or lighting halo.
sourceGeometry: CLD2, original SH1 Stalker; documentary render, no Grey Child proxy
